name_zh: 阿登纳/德国/西德建国/欧洲一体化/大西洋主义/奥斯汀
description_zh: 康拉德·阿登纳 (1876-1967) 西德首任总理 (1949-1963)，推动西德融入西方阵营，巴黎条约/罗马条约奠定欧洲共同体基础，大西洋主义锚定美德关系，社会市场经济确立战后经济奇迹基础，年过七十仍执政十四年。
description_en: Konrad Adenauer (1876-1967) West Germany first Chancellor (1949-1963), drove West Germany integration into Western bloc, Paris/Rome Treaties founded European Community basis, Atlanticism anchored US-Germany relations, social market economy established post-war economic miracle foundation, governed fourteen years past age seventy.
reason_zh: 阿登纳代表战败国如何通过主动西向融入重塑国家身份，展示了社会市场经济如何平衡资本效率与社会公正，其大西洋主义与欧洲一体化双轮驱动奠定现代德国外交基石。
reason_en: Adenauer represents how defeated nation reshapes national identity through proactive Western integration, demonstrating how social market economy balances capitalist efficiency and social justice, his Atlanticism and European integration dual-wheel driving modern German diplomacy foundation.
steps_zh: 研究阿登纳早年科隆市长/纳粹迫害/战后崛起
分析1949年西德建国与基本法确立
探讨1951巴黎条约/1957罗马条约欧洲一体化
评估社会市场经济/大西洋主义/奥斯汀外交
总结西德建国/欧洲一体化/大西洋主义/社会市场经济四重遗产
steps_en: Study Adenauer early Cologne Mayor/Nazi persecution/postwar rise
Analyze 1949 West Germany founding and Basic Law establishment
Explore 1951 Paris Treaty/1957 Rome Treaty European integration
Summarize West Germany founding/European integration/Atlanticism/social market economy quadruple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握战败国如何通过主动西向融入重塑国家尊严，理解社会市场经济如何实现资本效率与社会公正平衡，评估阿登纳模式对现代德国外交/经济/欧盟的决定性奠基。
expected_en: Master how defeated nation reshapes national dignity through proactive Western integration, grasp social market economy achieving capitalist efficiency and social justice balance, evaluate Adenauer model decisive foundation for modern German diplomacy/economy/EU.
case_zh: 1949 首任总理；1955 巴黎条约/加入北约；1957 罗马条约；1963 卸任。西德建国/欧洲一体化/大西洋主义/社会市场范式永存。
case_en: 1949 first Chancellor; 1955 Paris Treaty/NATO entry; 1957 Rome Treaty; 1963 retirement. West Germany founding/European integration/Atlanticism/social market paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: West Germany founding; European integration; Atlanticism; social market economy
